gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads stretched out and dignified, its open counters leaving room around every word. And Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, is the loud, expressive voice for the top line.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Commanding, a little cheeky: Sniglet keeps its terminals short of curling. BhuTuka Expanded One slows a long page to a leisurely walk, its curvy text serif letters unclamped and literary.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-glegoo: Bold stencil lettering sets the tone, with Snowburst One leaving wide bridges between its tall letters. But Glegoo, a classic serif with big counters, is the one that carries refined, editorial text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hanuman: Snowburst One cuts its tall lowercase like a stencil sheet, bold and expressive. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase, makes a longer stretch feel traditional and refined.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noticia-text: Wide bridges between stencil letters mark Snowburst One right away, with an opening like a sprung paper clip. And Noticia Text, a serif with big entrances into its curves, settles in beneath it, literary and dignified.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-scope-one: Scope One has counters that spill into the surrounding space, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. And a long read in it feels traditional and refined, set beneath the stencil boldness of Snowburst One.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-suwannaphum: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges and tall lowercase. It earns its keep big and short, while Suwannaphum, a serif with a high squared-off x-height, stays dignified and editorial.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-epunda-slab: Pipe-cleaner strokes, outsized lowercase, wide-open curves: that is Tektur. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded forms, gives it a dignified partner.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-fauna-one: Pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase give Tektur a distinctive look, its bowls never thinning at the sides. But Fauna One, a text serif with a tall middle band, makes a long read feel literary and dignified.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-kadwa: Tektur traces its glyphs with one thickness, so it does its best work as an expressive, outsized headline. But Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and a larger x-height, takes over for classic, editorial text.
